name: All papers until 1940
postgresql: SELECT title, year, Authors.id, Authors.name FROM Publications LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors ON Publications.key = PublicationAuthors.publication_key LEFT JOIN Authors ON PublicationAuthors.author_id = Authors.key WHERE year <= 1940 ORDER BY year ASC, title ASC;
duckdb: SELECT title, year, Authors.id, Authors.name FROM Publications LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors ON Publications.key = PublicationAuthors.publication_key LEFT JOIN Authors ON PublicationAuthors.author_id = Authors.key WHERE year <= 1940 ORDER BY year ASC, title ASC;
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> SELECT ?title ?author ?author_label ?year WHERE { ?paper dblp:title ?title . ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year . ?author rdfs:label ?author_label . FILTER (?year <= "1940"^^xsd:gYear) } ORDER BY ASC(?year) ASC(?title)

name: All papers with their title
postgresql: SELECT key, title FROM Publications;
duckdb: SELECT key, title FROM Publications;
sparql: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?paper ?title WHERE { ?paper dblp:title ?title .}

name: All Authors matching REGEX
postgresql: SELECT key, name, COUNT(*) FROM Authors WHERE name ~* 'M.*D.*' GROUP BY key, name;
duckdb: SELECT key, name, COUNT(*) FROM Authors WHERE regexp_matches(name, 'M.*D.*', 'i') GROUP BY key, name;
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?author ?author_label ?count WHERE { { SELECT ?author ?author_label (COUNT(?paper) as ?count) WHERE { ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . ?paper dblp:publishedIn "SIGIR" . ?author rdfs:label ?author_label . } GROUP BY ?author ?author_label } FILTER REGEX(STR(?author_label), "M.*D.*", "i") } ORDER BY DESC(?count)

name: All papers published in SIGIR
postgresql: SELECT key, title, year FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Venues ON Publications.venue_id = Venues.id AND Venues.name = 'SIGIR';
duckdb: SELECT key, title, year FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Venues ON Publications.venue_id = Venues.id AND Venues.name = 'SIGIR';
sparql: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>SELECT ?paper ?title ?year WHERE {?paper dblp:title ?title .?paper dblp:publishedIn "SIGIR" .?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year}ORDER BY DESC(?year)

name: Number of papers by venue
postgresql: SELECT Venues.name, COUNT(Publications.key) FROM Venues LEFT JOIN Publications ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id GROUP BY Venues.name;
duckdb: SELECT Venues.name, COUNT(Publications.key) FROM Venues LEFT JOIN Publications ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id GROUP BY Venues.name;
sparql: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>SELECT ?venue (COUNT(?paper) as ?count) WHERE {?paper dblp:publishedIn ?venue .}GROUP BY ?venue ORDER BY DESC(?count)

name: Average number of authors per paper by year
postgresql: SELECT publication.year, COUNT(pub_authors.author_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT(publication.title)) FROM Publications as publication JOIN PublicationAuthors as pub_authors ON pub_authors.publication_key = publication.key GROUP BY publication.year;
duckdb: SELECT publication.year, COUNT(pub_authors.author_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT(publication.title)) FROM Publications as publication JOIN PublicationAuthors as pub_authors ON pub_authors.publication_key = publication.key GROUP BY publication.year;
sparql: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?year (COUNT(?author)/COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?authors_per_paper) WHERE ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author .  ?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year . } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY DESC(?year)

name: All papers authored by the top 50 paper authors
postgresql: SELECT DISTINCT Publications.title FROM Publications JOIN PublicationAuthors ON Publications.key = PublicationAuthors.publication_key WHERE PublicationAuthors.author_id IN (SELECT author_id FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESCLIMIT 50 ) as subquery;
duckdb: SELECT DISTINCT Publications.title FROM Publications JOIN PublicationAuthors ON Publications.key = PublicationAuthors.publication_key WHERE PublicationAuthors.author_id IN (SELECT author_id FROM PublicationAuthors GROUP BY author_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 50 ) As subquery;
sparql: PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?paper ?title WHERE { { SELECT ?author (COUNT(?paper) as ?paper_count) WHERE { ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author . } GROUP BY ?author ORDER BY DESC(?paper_count) LIMIT 50 } ?paper dblp:title ?title . ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author .}

name: All last names ordered by number of authors
postgresql: SELECT last_name, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT (REGEXP_MATCHES(name, '^.* ([^\d]+)( \d+)?$')) [1] AS last_name FROM Authors) AS subquery GROUP BY last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
duckdb: SELECT last_name, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT regexp_extract(name, "^.* ([^\d]+)( \d+)?$", 1) AS last_name FROM Authors) AS subquery GROUP BY last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?first_name (COUNT(?author) as ?count_author) WHERE { ?author rdf:type dblp:Person . ?author rdfs:label ?author_label . BIND (REPLACE(?author_label, "^.* ([^\\d]+)( \\d+)?$", "$1") as ?first_name)} GROUP BY ?first_name ORDER BY DESC(?count_author)

name: All authors ordered by number of distinct co-author
postgresql: SELECT Authors.name FROM Authors JOIN Publication_Authors as auth_pub ON auth_pub.author_id = Authors.key JOIN Publication_Authors as pub_auth ON pub_auth.publication_key = auth_pub.publication_key AND pub_auth.author_id != Authors.key GROUP BY Authors.name ORDER BY Count(DISTINCT (pub_auth.author_id)) DESC;
duckdb: SELECT Authors.name FROM Authors JOIN Publication_Authors as auth_pub ON auth_pub.author_id = Authors.key JOIN Publication_Authors as pub_auth ON pub_auth.publication_key = auth_pub.publication_key AND pub_auth.author_id != Authors.key GROUP BY Authors.name ORDER BY Count(DISTINCT (pub_auth.author_id)) DESC;
sparql: PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX dblps: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema-2020-07-01#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT ?author (COUNT(DISTINCT(?author2)) as ?author_count) WHERE {   ?author rdf:type dblp:Person .   ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author .   ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author2 .   FILTER (?author != ?author2 ) } GROUP BY ?author ORDER BY DESC(?author_count)

name: All co-authors by number of papers
postgresql: SELECT auth1.name, auth2.name, COUNT(*) FROM PublicationAuthors as pubauth1 JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth2 ON pubauth1.publication_key = pubauth2.publication_key AND pubauth1.author_id != pubauth2.author_id JOIN Authors as auth1 ON auth1.key = pubauth1.author_id JOIN Authors as auth2 ON auth2.key = pubauth2.author_id GROUP BY auth1.name, auth2.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
duckdb: SELECT auth1.name, auth2.name, COUNT(*) FROM PublicationAuthors as pubauth1 JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth2 ON pubauth1.publication_key = pubauth2.publication_key AND pubauth1.author_id != pubauth2.author_id JOIN Authors as auth1 ON auth1.key = pubauth1.author_id JOIN Authors as auth2 ON auth2.key = pubauth2.author_id GROUP BY auth1.name, auth2.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> SELECT ?author_name1 ?author_name2 (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) as ?count_paper) WHERE { ?author1  rdf:type dblp:Person . ?author1 rdfs:label ?author_name1 . ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author1 . ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author2 . ?author2 rdfs:label ?author_name2 . FILTER (?author1 != ?author2) . } GROUP BY ?author_name1 ?author_name2 ORDER BY DESC(?count_paper)

name: Average amount of citations in a paper
postgresql: SELECT AVG(cites) FROM ( SELECT Publications.key, COUNT(ref.dest_pub) AS cites FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Reference as ref ON ref.origin_pub = Publications.key AND ref.type='cite' GROUP BY Publications.key ) AS subquery;
duckdb: SELECT AVG(cites) FROM ( SELECT Publications.key, COUNT(ref.dest_pub) AS cites FROM Publications LEFT JOIN Reference as ref ON ref.origin_pub = Publications.key AND ref.type='cite' GROUP BY Publications.key ) AS subquery;
sparql: PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#> SELECT (AVG(?citations) AS ?avg_citations) WHERE { { SELECT ?citingentity (COUNT(?citedentity) AS ?citations) WHERE { ?citation cito:hasCitedEntity ?citedentity . ?citation cito:hasCitingEntity ?citingentity . } GROUP BY ?citingentity ORDER BY DESC(?citations) } }

name: Minimum amount of citations in a paper

name: Group Concat of paper authors
postgresql: SELECT pub.key, string_agg(Authors.name) FROM Publications as pub LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth ON pubauth.publication_key = pub.key LEFT JOIN Authors ON pubauth.author_id = Authors.key GROUP BY pub.key;
duckdb: SELECT pub.key, string_agg(Authors.name) FROM Publications as pub LEFT JOIN PublicationAuthors as pubauth ON pubauth.publication_key = pub.key LEFT JOIN Authors ON pubauth.author_id = Authors.key GROUP BY pub.key;

name: Union of two Venues
postgresql: SELECT * FROM Publications JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id AND Venues.name = 'CoRR' UNION SELECT * FROM Publications JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id AND Venues.name = 'IEEE Access';
duckdb: SELECT * FROM Publications JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id AND Venues.name = 'CoRR' UNION SELECT * FROM Publications JOIN Venues ON Venues.id = Publications.venue_id AND Venues.name = 'IEEE Access';
